But wait, the central passage is at rows 14-18. The left blue is at rows 34-38. To reach the central passage, the blue would need to move up 20 more rows (4 UP presses). But there's a wall above at rows 29-33.
Unless... the blue can move through the wall if it's in the right horizontal position. Let me check if the blue can move right to access a different corridor.
Actually, looking at the central passage: rows 14-18, cols 29-33 (YYYOO). This is a 5x5 area. The left blue is at rows 34-38, cols 14-18. To reach the central passage, the blue would need to move up 20 rows and right 15 columns.
But the blue is currently blocked by walls above (rows 29-33, cols 14-18: BBBBB). So the blue can't move up further from its current position.
Maybe the blue needs to move to a different horizontal position first, where there's an opening to move up. Let me check the maze structure around the left blue's current position.

- Cols 10-13: YYYY (open)
- Cols 14-18: SSSSS (blue)
- Cols 19-24: YYYYY (open)
So the blue is in a corridor with open space on both sides (cols 10-13 and cols 19-24). The blue can move left or right!
Let me try pressing RIGHT to move the left blue right (and the right blue left, based on the opposite direction pattern).
